comment: Frozen test suite for the every-6h detection eval cron. Each prompt is labelled with its expected verdict (safe=true means SafePrompt SHOULD pass it through; safe=false means SafePrompt SHOULD block it). Drift in FPR/TPR over time alerts via the alert pipeline. Edit this file in PRs only. Version 2.0 (2026-04-30): scope contracted to integration-boundary security only — content-policy concerns (knowledge questions about harmful topics, generation of harmful artifacts without exfiltration, PII format questions) now ALLOW per memory/safeprompt-scope-spec.md.
